CHIRPS v3 final daily RNL GeoTIFF recorded from the Climate Hazards Center archive.

Source: https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS/v3.0/daily/final/rnl/2024/chirps-v3.0.rnl.2024.01.01.tif
Recorded on 2026-11-15. The fixture is an unmodified 4 by 4 pixel window from
source rows 908-911 and columns 1788-1791 (EPSG:4326, 0.05 degree cells),
around Guatemala City. The source is CC BY 4.0; attribute the Climate Hazards
Center CHIRPS3 Data Repository (https://doi.org/10.15780/G2JQ0P).
Tests never call the live archive.
